title: spec: Bound root join-tracking table with LRU eviction
description:
Root per-IID join-tracking table has no size bound. Attacker generates cheap Ed25519 keypairs to exhaust root memory.

Fix: Add to 02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.5.5.2:
'Implementations MUST bound the per-IID join tracking table. Recommended: 1024 entries with LRU eviction based on last request timestamp.'

Ref: worker6-h4pl
